title: Anthropic Skill Frontmatter Schema (Official Fields Only)
description: Validates YAML frontmatter of SKILL.md files against Anthropic's 10 official Claude Code skill fields ONLY. No Jerry extension fields permitted. Source: code.claude.com/docs/en/skills (March 2026). See skill-canonical-v1.schema.json for Jerry extension fields.
$comment: SYNC NOTE: The skill_name $def is duplicated in skill-canonical-v1.schema.json. Changes to the name pattern, maxLength, or reserved-word exclusions MUST be applied to BOTH schemas in the same commit.

skill_name.description: Skill name. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only. Max 64 characters. Must not contain 'claude' or 'anthropic' (reserved by Anthropic).

tool_name.description: Tool identifier (e.g., Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch, Task).

name.description: Display name for the skill. Becomes the /slash-command. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only (max 64 chars). Must not contain 'claude' or 'anthropic'. If omitted, Claude Code uses the directory name.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it. Claude uses this to decide when to apply the skill automatically. Max 1024 chars. No XML angle brackets.

argument-hint.description: Hint shown during autocomplete to indicate expected arguments.

disable-model-invocation.description: Set to true to prevent Claude from automatically loading this skill.

user-invocable.description: Set to false to hide from the / menu.

allowed-tools.description: Tools Claude can use without asking permission when this skill is active.

oneOf.description: Comma-separated tool list (e.g., 'Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep').

model.description: Model to use when this skill is active.

context.description: Set to 'fork' to run in a forked subagent context.

agent.description: Which subagent type to use when context: fork is set.

hooks.description: Hooks scoped to this skill's lifecycle.

$comment_additionalProperties: Set to true so Anthropic can add new official fields without breaking CI. Jerry extension field enforcement is handled by SCV-001 in SkillComposeValidator, not by this schema.
